articles.title: With over 50,000 tourists visiting Agra daily, video of more than 100 monkeys swarming Taj Mahal lawn raises safety concerns; watch
articles.summary: A widely circulated video showing over 100 monkeys swarming the Taj Mahal lawn in Agra has raised significant safety concerns for tourists. With the iconic monument attracting over 50,000 visitors daily, authorities are facing pressure to implement effective measures to control the growing monkey menace. This incident underscores the challenges in managing wildlife in high-traffic heritage sites, impacting visitor experience and safety.
